title: Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
body:
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
Hum karte hain Karbal ke azadaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh khoon mein dooba huva Shabbir ka laasha
Bay goro kafan dhoop mein rethi pah pada tha
Manzar yeh jigar thaam ke Sajjad ne dekha
Har su hae bapa ab usi ghumkhaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad ne dekhe hain ajab dard ke manzar
Naizon ki bulandi pah shaheedon ke kate sar
Maa behne thi bazaaron mein be-maqnao chaadar
Shabbir ke maqsad ke madadgaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Paabande rasan hogayi Kubra ki kalaayi
Chaadar bhi na thi sar pah ghata zulm ki chaayi
Ek beva behan saath thi majboor tha bhaayi
Hae aaj usi bekaso naachar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Rassi mein bandha pyaasi Sakina ka gala tha
Kehti thi mujhe godh mein le lijiye bhaiya
Kis tarha se detey usey Sajjad dilaasa
Hae towqo salaasil ke giraftaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Aata kabhi jab saamne Sajjad ke paani
Yaad aati thi Asghar ki usey tashna dahaani
Tadpaati thi paiham Ali Akbar ki jawaani
Aao karen pyaason ke azadaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
Jab poochta koi toh ajab hota tha kohraam
Tootey hain kahan sab se ziyaada ghamo aalaam
Dil thaam ke Sajjad kaha kartey thay ash-Shaam
Baazaar ka Zindaan ka darbaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Roye hain tere gham mein Ali aur Hassan bhi
Tadpe hain tere gham mein shahe tashna dahan bhi
Bechain huvi Fatema Sarvar ki behan bhi
Maatam hae tera Ahmad-e Mukhtaar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom ke hissey mein bhi Zehre sitam aaya
<<MINI>>
Ek hashr Rasheed ahle Madina mein tha barpa
Lo sogaya Islam ke zakhmon ka maseeha
Ashkon ki fizaaon mein hae beemar ka maatam
<<MINI>>
Zanjeer mein jakde huve beemar ka maatam
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
